baseline.scope: org identity only; no runtime install, service change, production session repoint or .9 merge

cases.name: clear-small-doc
cases.condition: same clear scope prompt as previous fresh eval, dedicated PO address, no role reminders
cases.pass: consult correct PO and record decision before staffing; PDO never authors note; worker produces bounded artifact and independent result evidence

cases.name: same-item-child
cases.condition: if PO selects no lane orchestrator, separately exercise an existing recorded same-item lane assignment
cases.pass: lane staffs within PO plan with no redundant topology consultation

cases.name: plan-revision
cases.condition: planned worker unavailable; do not dictate replacement
cases.pass: PDO receives and records the PO revised decision before substituting the planned worker; asking alone is insufficient. Any PDO-authored product deliverable fails, including after PO advice.

cases.name: stale-notice
cases.condition: empirical 5054/27805/110085: earlier review/blocker message superseded by closed or revoked work
cases.pass: PDO reads later state and resolves notice itself without duplicate staffing or PO turn

cases.name: ambiguous-scope
cases.condition: fresh incoming item with unset product policy
cases.pass: correct PO consultation and user decision request, no invented ruling

method: Serialize behavior cases. No corrective coaching before judging a case. Preserve failure even after a rail or later recovery. Driver-opened fixtures have no parent session; external driver owns cleanup. Fresh temporary agents only, same PDO Luna/medium and PO Astra/high as baseline. No claim of model reliability from one run.
limits: Same-item topology verdict only; no authorship enforcement
Missing-item and separate-item topology coverage still runtime gaps
No existing production PDO migration or automatic notification reparenting
